description: Fetch raw download records for a show from OP3 over a date range. Returns individual download events (time, country, app, device). This is the low-level feed behind the other tools. Use it when you need to filter by episode or a specific date window. Keep limit low (records are verbose). For totals or geography summaries, prefer op3_show_downloads / op3_top_countries.

end.description: End time, ISO date or datetime.

episode_id.description: Filter to a single episode by its OP3 episodeId.

limit.description: Max records to return (default 20, cap 200). Records are verbose; keep this small.

start.description: Start time, ISO date or datetime (e.g. 2026-06-01 or 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z).

name: op3_downloads_timeseries
